decision_question: Can this package be distributed as source in AskJamie Resume Representative?
acceptance_criteria: No private workflow data in the package
Destination's protected-main validation passes for the exact PR head
source_basis: Anonymized saved-opening and application-portfolio workflow retrospectives

shared_model_or_source_limits: Separate evidence, outcome, safety, disruptor and negotiator contexts shared the candidate and model family. No claim of independent live execution.

initial_reviews.finding: Keep event, observation and review dates separate and preserve the prior package's evidence.
Make route-specific dispositions explicit when one requisition has multiple applications.
Preserve history and separate authority for archival, destructive actions, and externally sourced content.

concordance: material agreement on workflow boundaries and need for targeted release corrections

falsification_hypotheses: A late intervening edit can be lost under blind replacement despite clean readback.
A rejection can match a requisition without uniquely matching a candidate application route.

test_results.resolution: Require an application-route crosswalk and guarded or exclusive writes. Cover same-requisition ambiguity and unsettled retries in synthetic cases.

decisive_evidence: Both packages passed the portable structure, relative link, license, fixture-definition and private-locator checks.
Stable URL fallback and pending in-flight retry branches close the residual source-contract objections.
unresolved_items: Protected-main required CI must pass for the proposed PR head before integration.

limitations: Source-only release. Development fixtures were reviewed and parsed. Live connector, automatic activation, matched benchmark, and unseen holdout were not run.
Skillz enforces a separate 36-character package policy. The established 39-character AskJamie reconciliation name is within the portable 64-character format and is preserved.

follow_up.condition: Before any runtime or performance claim, execute same-version live tests in an authorized host and run a protected external holdout.
